Hannah / team — quick legal triage below (I've annotated the attached doc with inline comments):

1) DPA: prefix/KV cache retention 
   - We are comfortable with shared caching only if we can guarantee logical separation and inability to reconstruct customer data cross-tenant. Practically, that means: token-level hashing + strict isolation of unencrypted KV entries.
   - If Vendormate requires cross-tenant shared KV cache for performance, we can accept conditional language that requires explicit consent per customer and adds audit logging. This is negotiable but not default.

2) Subprocessors / notifications
   - Prior notice + 10 business days to object is standard; we will accept notification + 15 business-day objection window for strategic partners. We will not agree to unilateral veto of subprocessors unless the processor handles regulated data (PHI/PCI).

3) Termination & wind-down
   - 60-day wind-down is fine but we need an SLA for data export and secure deletion. Recommend 45 days for export + confirmation of deletion within 90 days.

4) SOW — firm cap for month 1 work
   - We can set a not-to-exceed amount for onboarding month 1. Jordan, please include preliminary ops estimate to pick a number.

Next steps: Jordan — ops estimate by EOD Monday (10/05). Hannah — I'll prepare a tracked-changes MSA/DPA to send back; prefer to split commercial (SOW caps) and legal (DPA/MSA) threads to speed procurement.

Kimberly Park
